L27: # History-making Beechcraft T-6C Texan II sale supports the U.S.-Vietnam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, advances U.S. interests in the Indo-Pacific Region
L28: 
L29: 【12†Image: DLIR0027 - Edited.jpg†d21buns5ku92am.cloudfront.net】
L30: 
L31:   * jpg
L32: 
L33:   *   * Delivery of Cutting-Edge Training Aircraft Expands U.S.-Vietnam Security Cooperation
L34: WICHITA, Kan. (Nov. 25, 2024) – Textron Aviation Defense today announced the arrival of five Beechcraft T-6C Texan II Integrated Training System (ITS) aircraft in support of the Vietnam Air Defense Air Force (ADAF) pilot training program at Phan Thiet Airbase. The historic delivery of the first of 12 T-6C Texan II ITS aircraft highlights the on-time fulfillment of the inaugural Foreign Military Sales (FMS) program established between the U.S. Air Force (USAF) and the ADAF.
L35: Contracted in August 2022, the full fleet of 12 T-6C aircraft is anticipated to be delivered by mid-2025.
L36: The Beechcraft T-6C Texan II is designed and manufactured by Textron Aviation Defense LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of 【13†Textron Aviation†txtav.com】 Inc., a 【14†Textron Inc.†www.textron.com】 (NYSE:TXT) company.
L37: “It’s an honor to support the United States and its Comprehensive Strategic Partnership with Vietnam as together they focus on a prosperous, open, resilient, and peaceful Indo-Pacific Region,” said Travis Tyler, President and CEO, Textron Aviation Defense LLC. “We also welcome the Vietnam Air Defense Air Force as the 14th nation to place its confidence in the T-6 Texan II and we celebrate the arrival of the T-6C at Phan Thiet Airbase.”
L38: 
L39: 【15†YouTube embed†cdn.embedly.com】
L40: Delivery of Beechcraft T-6C Texan II to the Vietnam Air Defense Air Force
L41: 
L42: The initial USAF FMS contract award features three T-6C ITS aircraft, site survey, ground support equipment, two spare engines, spare parts, personal life support equipment, external fuel tanks and pylons, aircraft ferry, program support and country specific technical orders. Subsequent contract awards increased the ADAF fleet of T-6C aircraft to twelve.
L43: ## About the Beechcraft T-6 Texan II
L44: The Beechcraft T-6 Texan II is the world’s premier military flight trainer. Backed by more than 90 years of experience delivering more than 250,000 aircraft worldwide, the Beechcraft T-6 Texan II’s low acquisition, operating and sustainment costs enable global air forces to fast-track pilot production.
L45: With an installed base that more than quadruples its closest competitor, the family of Beechcraft T-6 Texan II aircraft has been the world’s number one Integrated Training System (ITS) for more than 20 years. The Beechcraft T-6 Texan II capitalizes on an active production line with an industry-leading Manufacturing Readiness Level (MRL) rating of 10 as well as a proven supply chain and the affordability of 85 percent parts commonality with the 【16†Beechcraft AT-6E Wolverine†defense.txtav.com】.
L46: To date, the global fleet of more than 1,000 Beechcraft T-6 Texan II aircraft has surpassed 5 million flight hours across 14 nations and two NATO flight schools.
L47: A vital asset, the T-6 empowers global pilot training across the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) Flight Training program in Canada, the Euro NATO Joint Jet Pilot Training Program (ENJJPT) at Sheppard AFB, Texas and the U.S. Air Force Aviation Leadership Program as well as the U.S.
L48: Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps, Army and Coast Guard, the Hellenic Air Force, the Argentine Air Force, the Israeli Air Force, the Royal Air Force, the Iraqi Air Force, the Royal Canadian Air Force, Mexican Navy, the Mexican Air Force, the Royal Moroccan Air Force, the Colombian Air Force, the Royal New Zealand Air Force, the Royal Thai Air Force, Tunisian Air Force and the Vietnam Air Defense Air Force.

L75: ## About Textron Aviation Defense LLC
L76: With a legacy of thousands of proven Beechcraft and Cessna Integrated Training Systems produced and missionized in America’s Heartland since WWII, military customers turn to Textron Aviation Defense when they need airborne solutions for their critical missions. Provider of the world’s foremost military flight trainer, Textron Aviation Defense equips militaries worldwide and leads in low acquisition, sustainment and training costs.
L77: The Beechcraft T-6 Texan II fleet of more than 1,000 aircraft has logged more than 5 million hours across two NATO military flight schools and fourteen countries since 2001. Textron Aviation Defense is a subsidiary of Textron Aviation Inc.
L78: For more information, visit 【21†www.defense.txtav.com†www.defense.txtav.com】 | 【22†www.scorpionjet.com†nam02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com】.
L79: ## About Textron Inc.
L80: 
L81: Textron Inc. is a multi-industry company that leverages its global network of aircraft, defense, industrial and finance businesses to provide customers with innovative solutions and services. Textron is known around the world for its powerful brands such as Bell, Cessna, Beechcraft, Pipstrel, Jacobsen, Kautex, Lycoming, E-Z-GO, Arctic Cat, Textron Systems, and TRU Simulation + Training.

L87: #### About Textron Aviation
L88: 
L89: About Textron Aviation Inc.
L90: We have been inspiring the journey of flight for nearly 100 years. Textron Aviation Inc., a Textron Inc. company, has empowered our collective talent across the Beechcraft, Cessna, Hawker and Pipistrel brands to design and deliver the best aviation experience for our customers.
L91: With a range that includes everything from business jets, turboprops, light and high-performance pistons, to special mission, military trainer and defense aircraft, Textron Aviation has the most versatile and comprehensive aviation product portfolio in the world and a workforce that has produced more than half of all general aviation aircraft worldwide.
L92: Customers in more than 170 countries rely on our legendary performance, reliability and versatility, along with our trusted global customer service network, for affordable, productive and flexible flight. For more information, visit 【23†www.txtav.com.†www.txtav.com】

L38: ## JABATAN KERAJAAN DIINGATKAN JANGAN LAYAN SURAT TIDAK GUNA BAHASA KEBANGSAAN – PM ANWAR
L39: 
L40: 25 Oktober 2023
L41: 
L42: 【18†Image】
L43: 
L44: CYBERJAYA, 25 Okt (Bernama) — Perdana Menteri Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim hari ini mengingatkan jabatan kerajaan untuk tidak melayan atau memulangkan sahaja mana-mana surat yang menggunakan selain bahasa kebangsaan iaitu bahasa Melayu.
L45: Berucap merasmikan Karnival Dekad Bahasa Kebangsaan dan Dekad Membaca Kebangsaan di sini, beliau menyedari terdapat sikap yang dirasakan “terlajak” atau “terpesong” oleh beberapa pihak yang sering kali cuba meninggalkan asas Perlembagaan Persekutuan untuk berhubung dengan jabatan kerajaan dalam bahasa kebangsaan.
L46: “Jadi saya ingatkan hal ini, kalau dalam kalangan syarikat tempatan dan universiti tempatan termasuk swasta, arahannya ialah siapa sahaja menulis dalam bahasa lain selain bahasa kebangsaan, surat itu akan dipulangkan.
L47: 
L48: “Pemerkasaan budaya, bahasa dan sastera itu sesuatu yang integral dalam pembinaan bangsa, jadi jangan kita cuba meremehkan.
L49: “Dan, saya harap peringatan ini diambil kira. Arahan yang jelas, KPPA (Ketua Pengarah Perkhidmatan Awam Datuk Dr Zulkapli Mohamed) pun ada … tidak akan melayani sebarang surat yang  disampaikan rakyat atau syarikat tempatan selain daripada bahasa kebangsaan,” katanya.
L50: 
L51: Anwar berkata tindakan sedemikian tidak akan menjadikan Malaysia “sempit” kerana kerajaan juga tidak meremehkan penguasaan bahasa Inggeris.
L52: “Ini tidak menjadikan kita sempit, kerana saya sering kali mengingatkan rakan-rakan bahawa saya tidak mungkin diminta mengajar di Georgetown University, Washington DC kalau tidak dapat menguasai bahasa Inggeris. Saya tidak remehkan (penguasaan bahasa Inggeris),” katanya.
L53: 
L54: Sementara itu, Anwar berkata budaya membaca wajar dipraktikkan sejak muda lagi sebagai satu “keghairahan” dan bukan hanya wujud disebabkan mahu lulus peperiksaan.
L55: “Saya harap budaya ini harus dihidupkan kerana sebaik sahaja kita mampu membaca, menelaah dan menghadam barulah kita dapat insya-Allah, menguasai ilmu mendalam dalam semua bidang. Kalau tak kita jadi intelektual picisan,” kata beliau.
L56: 
L57: Anwar berkata dalam keghairahan meneroka pemikiran dan teknologi baharu, aspek penguasaan bahasa kebangsaan dan pemerkasaan budaya tidak boleh dibelakangkan.
L58: Beliau berkata walaupun aspek penerokaan bidang baharu menjadi fokus dalam kerangka Malaysia MADANI, ia tidak mungkin mematangkan negara tanpa usaha penguasaan bahasa dan pemerkasaan budaya.
L59: 
L60: “Kita tak nak orang ingat dalam keghairahan teroka pemikiran baharu tetapi kita tinggalkan landasan akar bumi (bahasa dan budaya),” kata Anwar.
L61:
